units.source_text: 大概是第二天的晚上，我们回到旅店，吃过饭，快要睡觉之前，突然争论起一个深奥的问题来。

en.t: It was probably the evening of the second day; after we returned to the inn, ate dinner, and were just about to go to bed, we suddenly began arguing about a profound question.

units.source_text: 因为昨天他跟我谈论日莲时，我没有上心，他不太高兴。

en.t: Because I had not paid much attention when he spoke to me about Nichiren the day before, he was rather displeased.

units.source_text: 他说：‘精神上没有上进心的人，都是蠢货。’

en.t: He said, “People who have no desire to improve themselves spiritually are all fools.”

units.source_text: 大有把我贬低为轻薄之徒的架势。

en.t: His manner strongly suggested that he was putting me down as a frivolous person.

units.source_text: 我心中正为小姐的事烦闷，自然不能对他这近乎侮辱之语一笑了之，便为自己辩解起来。

en.t: Since my mind was already troubled over the young lady, I naturally could not simply laugh off words that came close to an insult, and I began to defend myself.

units.source_text: 1.日莲：日本佛教日莲宗的教祖，信奉《法华经》。

en.t: 1. Nichiren: the founder of the Nichiren school of Japanese Buddhism, who revered the Lotus Sutra.
